name: jira_issue_update
description: Edits an issue; only the fields provided are updated. Status changes must go through jira_issue_transition (PUT /rest/api/3/issue/{issueIdOrKey})

issue_key.description: The ID or key of the issue to edit, for example RECON-101.

summary.description: The new one-line summary of the issue.

description.description: The new detailed description of the issue.

issue_type.description: The new issue type name, for example Bug, Task, or Story.

priority.description: The new priority name, for example Highest, High, Medium, Low.

labels.description: The full replacement comma-separated label list for the issue.
